parameters.query:
WITH prev AS (SELECT repeticiones FROM alertas_error WHERE clave=$1),
up AS (INSERT INTO alertas_error(clave,ultima_en,repeticiones) VALUES($1,now(),0)
  ON CONFLICT (clave) DO UPDATE SET
   ultima_en=CASE WHEN alertas_error.ultima_en<now()-interval '10 minutes' THEN now() ELSE alertas_error.ultima_en END,
   repeticiones=CASE WHEN alertas_error.ultima_en<now()-interval '10 minutes' THEN 0 ELSE alertas_error.repeticiones+1 END
  RETURNING ultima_en)
SELECT (SELECT ultima_en FROM up)=now() AS enviar, COALESCE((SELECT repeticiones FROM prev),0) AS repetidas_antes, COALESCE((SELECT valor FROM config WHERE clave='telegram_chat_operador'),'') AS chat
